title: 🚽 Disaster Sanitation Workshop
description: Join neighbors to learn how to prepare for any disaster that breaks our plumbing! All are welcome. Best practices for alternative bathrooms (twin bucket system and hands-free handwashing) and other disease prevention strategies. Organized by Foster/Powell NET; open to all!

title: Neighborhood Pod Starter Kit
description: Sorry, this workshop is now full! We will plan another one soon. Please submit the form to let us know you're interested and we'll let you know as soon as we have a date for the next one.

title: Meshcore: Off-grid communications
description: Meshcore is a simple, secure, off-grid mesh communications system. As a neighborhood, we can build our own low-cost, long-range, encrypted messaging network. You can still send messages even when WiFi, Cellular, and Starlink are down.

title: Fall City-wide Deployment Exercise (CDE)
description: Twice a year, NET teams all over the city role-play a disaster scenario and practice search and rescue, triage, radio communications, and Incident Command Structure. Lots of fun, and a great way to practice the skills you learned in basic training. If you're still waiting for a spot in Basic NET Training, you can participate as a Spontaneous Unaffiliated Volunteer (SUV).

title: 🔥 Fire Pan!
description: Fire Suppression hands-on practice. Mark will bring the fire pan and water extinguishers. P.A.S.S. - Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep.
